system.name: OCE (Orthogonal Concept Erasure)
system.one_liner: Editing-based concept erasure for text-to-image diffusion that applies layer-wise orthogonal transformations, erasing up to 100 concepts in 4.3 s.

content.variant_note: three lettered tiles of unequal width: two before and after image strips and a small matrix schematic, with a headline time set in the heading
content.argues: Multiplicative orthogonal editing erases single and many concepts cleanly, keeps non-target content intact and is fast, unlike additive weight updates.
content.subject: Before and after images for erased and kept concepts, and a matrix sketch of additive versus orthogonal multiplicative weight editing.

lessons.what_to_learn: Show an edit as before and after tile pairs with a colour-coded block arrow (orange changed, green preserved) and strike-through labels for removed concepts, then tie it to the method with a tiny matrix sketch contrasting W + Δ with P × W.
lessons.suits: Editing, removal or unlearning methods whose benefit shows as changed versus unchanged outputs plus a one-line formal change.

evidence: OCE reformulates previous additive editing as multiplicative orthogonal editing, introducing a new editing-based concept erasure paradigm.
OCE supports efficient large-scale multi-concept erasure of up to 100 concepts at once, requiring only 4.3 s.
Most existing methods define concept erasure as additive updates of model parameters W + ∆, as shown in Fig. 1(c).

summary: OCE (Orthogonal Concept Erasure) removes concepts from text-to-image diffusion models by multiplying the weights with an orthogonal transformation instead of adding an update. Figure 1 is a three-panel highlight strip separated by dashed lines. Panel (a) shows before and after image tiles (a large image plus three thumbnails) for Van Gogh style and airplane, headed by red strike-through text with an eraser icon, next to an untouched cat marked in green with an umbrella icon. Panel (b) does the same for 100 celebrity faces, with the headline 'in only 4.3 s' highlighted. Panel (c) contrasts the previous additive update W + Δ with OCE's multiplicative P × W using grids of yellow squares and a blue weight box.
summary_zh: OCE 用正交变换乘以权重来擦除扩散模型中的概念。图 1 三格并列：(a) 单概念擦除前后对比（梵高、飞机，非目标猫不变），(b) 100 位名人仅需 4.3 秒，(c) 用方格矩阵对比加法更新与乘法更新。
notes: P is labelled only 'P' in the figure; the caption and abstract call OCE's update multiplicative and orthogonal, the pre-screen called it a projection. Before and after rows carry no labels; the order is read from the arrows and the caption.
